title: Predictive Coding Implemented as a Hardware Substrate Computes Gradients faster than Backpropagation
abstract: arXiv:2603.18066v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Backpropagation has enabled modern deep learning but is difficult to realize as an online, fully distributed hardware system due to global error propagation, separate phases, and centralized memory. Predictive coding is an alternative learning algorithm with similar dynamics to backpropagation that arises from local prediction error dynamics. This paper shows that predictive coding can be instantiated as a discrete time digital hardware substrate, with local memory and computation, no instruction set architecture, and one physical core for each predictive-coding neuron. Each core stores its own activity and weights, communicates with the cores that it's connected to, and performs local gradient updates. By updating neuron cores concurrently, the architecture computes a network update in O(J+K) clock cycles. For dense layers of width n, this is O(n) cycles per update, compared with O(n^2) connection operations processed serially

translated_title: 预测编码实现为硬件基底，其梯度计算速度超过反向传播
translated_abstract: 反向传播促成了现代深度学习，但由于其全局误差传播、分离的训练阶段和集中式存储，难以实现为一个在线的、完全分布式的硬件系统。预测编码是一种与反向传播具有相似动力学的替代性学习算法，它源于局部预测误差动力学。本文表明，预测编码可以被实例化为一种离散时间数字硬件基底，具有局部存储和计算能力，无需指令集架构，且每个预测编码神经元对应一个物理核心。每个核心存储自身的活动和权重，与其所连接的核心进行通信，并执行局部梯度更新。通过并发更新神经元核心，该架构在 O(J+K) 个时钟周期内即可完成一次网络更新。对于宽度为 n 的密集层，每次更新仅需 O(n) 个周期，而相比之下，串行处理连接操作需要 O(n²) 次。
tldr: 本文将预测编码算法实例化为一种每个神经元对应一个物理核心的数字硬件基底，通过局部存储、通信与并发更新，使宽度为 n 的密集层的网络更新仅需 O(n) 个时钟周期，远快于反向传播串行处理所需的 O(n²) 次连接操作。
en_tdlr: This paper instantiates predictive coding as a discrete-time digital hardware substrate with one physical core per neuron, where concurrent local updates compute a dense layer's network update in O(n) clock cycles, far faster than backpropagation's O(n²) serially processed connection operations.
